label: Attorney discipline
caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF STEVEN ANTHONY LANG
text: Steven Anthony Lang, of Chicago, Illinois, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of August 5, 2019; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Steven Anthony Lang is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
